And when you come into the land, and plant any food tree, and you shall seal its fruit; three years it shall be for you sealed, it shall not be eaten.
And in the fourth year, all its fruit shall be sacred, a praise to Havayah.
And in the fifth year you shall eat its fruit, to increase for you its yield; I am Havayah your Elokim.
You shall not eat over the blood; you shall not practice divination, and you shall not practice soothsaying.
You shall not round the corner of your head, and you shall not mar the corner of your beard.
And a laceration for a soul you shall not make in your flesh, and a written imprint you shall not place upon you; I am Havayah.
Do not profane your daughter to make her a harlot, and the land shall not become licentious, and the land shall be filled with lewdness.
My Shabbosos you shall keep, and My Sanctuary you shall revere; I am Havayah.
Do not turn to the mediums and to the necromancers; do not seek to be defiled by them; I am Havayah your Elokim.
Before gray hair you shall rise, and honor the face of an elder, and fear your Elokim; I am Havayah.
And when a stranger sojourns with you in your land, you shall not mistreat him.
Like a native among you shall be for you the stranger who sojourns with you, and you shall love him as yourself, for strangers you were in the land of Mitzrayim; I am Havayah your Elokim.
You shall not do injustice in judgment, in measure, in weight, or in liquid measure.
Scales of righteousness, weights of righteousness, an ephah of righteousness, and a hin of righteousness shall be for you; I am Havayah your Elokim, who brought you out of the land of Mitzrayim.
And you shall keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them; I am Havayah.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:

And to the children of Yisroel you shall say: A man, a man from the children of Yisroel and from the stranger who sojourns in Yisroel, who gives from his seed to Molekh, he shall be put to death; the people of the land shall stone him with stone.
And I, I shall set My face against that man, and cut him off from the midst of his people, for from his seed he gave to Molekh, to defile My Sanctuary and to profane My holy name.
And if the people of the land hide their eyes from that man, in his giving from his seed to Molekh, not to put him to death.
And I shall set My face against that man and against his family, and cut off him and all who stray after him, to stray after Molekh, from the midst of their people.
And the soul that turns to the mediums and to the necromancers, to stray after them, and I shall set My face against that soul, and cut him off from the midst of his people.
And you shall sanctify yourselves, and be holy, for I am Havayah your Elokim.
And you shall keep My statutes and do them; I am Havayah who sanctifies you.
For a man, a man who curses his father and his mother, he shall be put to death; he cursed his father and his mother, his blood is upon him.
And a man who commits adultery with the wife of a man, who commits adultery with the wife of his neighbor, the adulterer and the adulteress shall be put to death.
And a man who lies with the wife of his father, he has uncovered the nakedness of his father, both of them shall be put to death, their blood is upon them.
And a man who lies with his daughter-in-law, both of them shall be put to death; a perversion they have done, their blood is upon them.
And a man who lies with a male as one lies with a woman, an abomination they have done, both of them, they shall be put to death, their blood is upon them.
And a man who takes a woman and her mother, lewdness it is; they shall burn him and them in fire, and there shall be no lewdness among you.
And a man who gives his lying to an animal, he shall be put to death, and the animal you shall kill.
And a woman who approaches any animal to mate with it, and you shall kill the woman and the animal; they shall be put to death, their blood is upon them.

And a man who takes his sister, the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, a disgrace it is, and they shall be cut off before the eyes of the children of their people; he has uncovered the nakedness of his sister, he shall bear his iniquity.

And a man who lies with a menstruating woman, and uncovers her nakedness, he has laid bare her source, and she has uncovered the source of her blood, and they shall be cut off, both of them, from the midst of their people.
And the nakedness of the sister of your mother and the sister of your father you shall not uncover, for he has laid bare his kin, their iniquity they shall bear.
And a man who lies with his aunt, he has uncovered the nakedness of his uncle, their sin they shall bear, childless they shall die.
And a man who takes the wife of his brother, an abhorrent act it is; he has uncovered the nakedness of his brother, childless they shall be.
And you shall keep all My statutes and all My ordinances, and do them, and the land shall not spew you out, which I am bringing you there to dwell in it.
And you shall not walk in the statutes of the nation that I am sending forth from before you, for all these they did, and I abhorred them.
And I said to you: You shall inherit their land, and I shall give it to you to inherit it, a land flowing with milk and honey; I am Havayah your Elokim, who distinguished you from the peoples.

And you shall distinguish between the pure beast and the impure, and between the impure bird and the pure, and you shall not make your souls detestable by the beast and by the bird and by all that creeps on the ground, which I distinguished for you to deem impure.
And you shall be holy to Me, for I am holy, Havayah, and I distinguished you from the peoples, to be Mine.
And a man or a woman, if there is in them a medium or a necromancer, they shall be put to death; they shall stone them with stones, their blood is upon them.
And Havayah said to Moshe: Speak to the priests, the sons of Aharon, and say to them: For a soul he shall not become impure among his people.
Except for his kin who is close to him, for his mother and for his father and for his son and for his daughter and for his brother.
And for his sister, the virgin, who is close to him, who has not been with a man, for her he may become impure.
He shall not become impure as a husband among his people, to profane himself.
They shall not make a baldness on their head, and the corner of their beard they shall not shave, and in their flesh they shall not make a laceration.
Holy they shall be to their Elokim, and they shall not profane the name of their Elokim, for the fire offerings of Havayah, they offer the food of their Elokim, and they shall be holy.
A licentious woman and a profaned woman they shall not take, and a woman divorced from her husband they shall not take, for holy he is to his Elokim.
And you shall sanctify him, for he offers the food of your Elokim; holy he shall be to you, for I am holy, Havayah who sanctifies you.
And the daughter of a man, a priest, if she profanes herself by acting licentiously, her father she profanes; in fire she shall be burned.

And the great priest among his brothers, on whose head was poured the anointing oil, and who filled his hand to wear the garments, his head he shall not let grow long, and his garments he shall not rend.
And over any souls of the dead he shall not come; for his father and for his mother he shall not become impure.
And from the Sanctuary he shall not go out, and he shall not profane the Sanctuary of his Elokim, for the crown of the anointing oil of his Elokim is upon him; I am Havayah.
And he shall take a woman in her virginity.
A widow, or a divorcée, or a profaned woman, or a licentious woman, these he shall not take, but a virgin from his people he shall take as a wife.
And he shall not profane his seed among his people, for I am Havayah who sanctifies him.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to Aharon, saying: A man from your seed, throughout their generations, in whom there shall be a blemish, he shall not approach to offer the food of his Elokim.
For any man in whom there is a blemish, he shall not approach: a blind man, or lame, or with a sunken nose, or with a protruding limb.
Or a man in whom there is a broken foot or a broken hand.
Or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or a cataract in his eye, or scabbed, or with a skin eruption, or with crushed testicles.

Any man in whom there is a blemish, from the seed of Aharon the priest, he shall not approach to offer the fire offerings of Havayah; a blemish is in him, the food of his Elokim he shall not approach to offer.
The food of his Elokim, from the holy of holies and from the holy, he may eat.
But to the curtain he shall not come, and to the altar he shall not approach, for a blemish is in him, and he shall not profane My Sanctuaries, for I am Havayah who sanctifies them.
And Moshe spoke to Aharon and to his sons, and to all the children of Yisroel.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:

Speak to Aharon and to his sons, and they shall separate themselves from the sacred items of the children of Yisroel, and they shall not profane My holy name, that which they sanctify to Me; I am Havayah.

Say to them: Throughout your generations, any man who approaches, from all your seed, to the sacred items that the children of Yisroel sanctify to Havayah, and his impurity is upon him, and that soul shall be cut off from before Me; I am Havayah.

A man, a man from the seed of Aharon, and he is a metzora or a zav, from the sacred items he shall not eat until he is purified; and he who touches any impurity of a soul, or a man from whom goes out a lying of seed.
Or a man who touches any swarming creature that makes him impure, or a man who makes him impure, for all his impurity.
A soul that touches him shall be impure until the evening, and he shall not eat from the sacred items, unless he bathes his flesh in water.
And the sun shall set, and he shall be purified, and afterward he shall eat from the sacred items, for his food it is.
A carcass or a torn animal he shall not eat, to become impure by it; I am Havayah.
And they shall keep My charge, and they shall not bear sin for it, and die by it, for they profane it; I am Havayah who sanctifies them.
And any stranger shall not eat sacred items; a resident of a priest and a hired laborer shall not eat sacred items.
And a priest, when he acquires a soul with his silver, he may eat of it, and one born in his house, they may eat of his food.
And the daughter of a priest, when she becomes the wife of a stranger, she, from the separated sacred items, shall not eat.

And the daughter of a priest, when she becomes a widow or a divorcée, and she has no seed, and she returns to the house of her father as in her youth, from the food of her father she may eat, and any stranger shall not eat of it.
And a man, when he eats a sacred item unwittingly, and he shall add its fifth to it, and give to the priest the sacred item.
And they shall not profane the sacred items of the children of Yisroel, that which they separate to Havayah.
And they shall cause them to bear the iniquity of guilt, in their eating their sacred items, for I am Havayah who sanctifies them.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:

Speak to Aharon and to his sons and to all the children of Yisroel, and say to them: A man, a man from the house of Yisroel and from the stranger in Yisroel, who presents his offering, for all their vows and for all their pledges that they present to Havayah as a burnt offering.
For your acceptance it shall be an unblemished male, from the cattle, from the sheep, and from the goats.
Anything in which there is a blemish you shall not offer, for it shall not be accepted for you.

And a man, when he presents a slaughtering of peace offerings to Havayah, to fulfill a vow or as a pledge, from the cattle or from the flock, unblemished it shall be for acceptance, any blemish shall not be in it.
Blind, or broken, or maimed, or a cyst, or scabbed, or with a skin eruption, you shall not offer these to Havayah, and a fire offering you shall not give of them upon the altar to Havayah.
And a bull or a sheep with an extended or truncated limb, as a pledge you may make it, but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
And bruised, or crushed, or torn, or cut, you shall not offer to Havayah, and in your land you shall not do so.
And from the hand of a son of a foreigner you shall not offer the food of your Elokim from any of these, for their corruption is in them, a blemish is in them, they shall not be accepted for you.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
An ox or a sheep or a goat, when it is born, and it shall be seven days under its mother, and from the eighth day onward it shall be accepted as an offering, a fire offering to Havayah.
And an ox or a sheep, it and its offspring you shall not slaughter on one day.
And when you slaughter a slaughtering of thanks to Havayah, for your acceptance you shall slaughter it.
On that day it shall be eaten; you shall not leave from it until morning; I am Havayah.
And you shall keep My commandments, and do them; I am Havayah.
And you shall not profane My holy name, and I shall be sanctified among the children of Yisroel; I am Havayah who sanctifies you.
Who brought you out of the land of Mitzrayim, to be for you as Elokim; I am Havayah.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: The appointed times of Havayah, which you shall proclaim as holy convocations, these are My appointed times.
Six days shall labor be done, and on the seventh day a sabbath of rest, a holy convocation, any labor you shall not do; a Shabbos it is to Havayah in all your dwellings.
These are the appointed times of Havayah, holy convocations, which you shall proclaim at their appointed time.
In the first month, on the fourteenth of the month, between the evenings, it is a Pesach to Havayah.
And on the fifteenth day of this month, it is the Festival of Unleavened Bread to Havayah; seven days unleavened bread you shall eat.
On the first day, a holy convocation it shall be for you; any toilsome labor you shall not do.
And you shall present a fire offering to Havayah seven days; on the seventh day, a holy convocation, any toilsome labor you shall not do.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: When you come to the land that I am giving to you, and you reap its harvest, and you shall bring the first sheaf of your harvest to the priest.
And he shall wave the sheaf before Havayah, for your acceptance; on the morrow of the sabbath the priest shall wave it.
And you shall do, on the day of your waving the sheaf, an unblemished lamb in its first year, as a burnt offering to Havayah.
And its meal offering shall be two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil, a fire offering to Havayah, a pleasing aroma, and its libation shall be wine, a fourth of a hin.
And bread and roasted grain and fresh kernels you shall not eat, until this very day, until you bring the offering of your Elokim; an eternal statute for your generations in all your dwellings.
And you shall count for yourselves from the morrow of the sabbath, from the day you bring the sheaf of the waving, seven complete weeks they shall be.
Until the morrow of the seventh week you shall count fifty days, and you shall present a new meal offering to Havayah.
From your dwellings you shall bring two loaves of waving bread, two tenths of fine flour they shall be, leavened they shall be baked, first fruits to Havayah.

And you shall offer with the bread seven unblemished lambs in their first year, and one bull, a young of the cattle, and two rams; they shall be a burnt offering to Havayah, and their meal offering and their libations, a fire offering of a pleasing aroma to Havayah.
And you shall do one goat as a sin offering, and two lambs in their first year as a slaughtering of peace offerings.
And the priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits, a wave offering before Havayah, with the two lambs; holy they shall be to Havayah, for the priest.
And you shall proclaim on this very day that it shall be a holy convocation for you, any toilsome labor you shall not do; an eternal statute in all your dwellings for your generations.

And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not finish the corner of your field in your reaping, and the gleanings of your harvest you shall not gather; for the poor and for the stranger you shall leave them; I am Havayah your Elokim.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, saying: In the seventh month, on the first of the month, there shall be for you a rest, a remembrance of a blast, a holy convocation.
Any toilsome labor you shall not do, and you shall present a fire offering to Havayah.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
But on the tenth of this seventh month, a Day of Atonement it is, a holy convocation it shall be for you, and you shall afflict your souls, and you shall present a fire offering to Havayah.
And any labor you shall not do on this very day, for a Day of Atonement it is, to atone for you before Havayah your Elokim.
For any soul that is not afflicted on this very day shall be cut off from its people.
And any soul that does any labor on this very day, I shall destroy that soul from among its people.
Any labor you shall not do; an eternal statute for your generations in all your dwellings.
A sabbath of rest it is for you, and you shall afflict your souls; on the ninth of the month, in the evening, from evening to evening you shall rest your sabbath.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, saying: On the fifteenth day of this seventh month, it is the Festival of Tabernacles, seven days to Havayah.
On the first day it shall be a holy convocation; any toilsome labor you shall not do.

Seven days you shall present a fire offering to Havayah; on the eighth day, a holy convocation it shall be for you, and you shall present a fire offering to Havayah; an assembly it is, any toilsome labor you shall not do.

These are the appointed times of Havayah, which you shall proclaim as holy convocations, to present a fire offering to Havayah, a burnt offering and a meal offering, a slaughtering and libations, the offering of each day on its own day.
Besides the Shabbosos of Havayah, and besides your gifts, and besides all your vows, and besides all your pledges, that you give to Havayah.

But on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you gather the produce of the land, you shall celebrate the Festival of Havayah seven days; on the first day there shall be a rest, and on the eighth day a rest.

And you shall take for yourselves on the first day the fruit of a pleasant tree, branches of date palms, and a bough of a leafy tree, and willows of the brook, and you shall rejoice before Havayah your Elokim seven days.
And you shall celebrate it as a festival to Havayah seven days in the year; an eternal statute for your generations; in the seventh month you shall celebrate it.
In booths you shall dwell seven days; every native in Yisroel shall dwell in booths.
So that your generations shall know that in booths I had the children of Yisroel dwell, when I took them out of the land of Mitzrayim; I am Havayah your Elokim.
And Moshe spoke the appointed times of Havayah to the children of Yisroel.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Command the children of Yisroel, and they shall take to you pure beaten olive oil for the light, to kindle a lamp continually.
Outside the curtain of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aharon shall arrange it, from evening until morning, before Havayah continually; an eternal statute for your generations.
Upon the pure menorah he shall arrange the lamps before Havayah continually.
And you shall take fine flour, and bake with it twelve loaves; two tenths shall be in the one loaf.
And you shall place them in two arrangements, six in each arrangement, upon the pure table before Havayah.
And you shall put pure frankincense upon the arrangement, and it shall be for the bread as a memorial portion, a fire offering to Havayah.
On the day of the Shabbos, on the day of the Shabbos, he shall arrange it before Havayah continually, from the children of Yisroel, an eternal covenant.
And it shall be for Aharon and for his sons, and they shall eat it in a holy place, for a holy of holies it is for him from the fire offerings of Havayah, an eternal statute.
And the son of a Yisroeli woman went out, and he was the son of a Mitzri man, among the children of Yisroel, and they fought in the camp, the son of the Yisroeli woman and the Yisroeli man.
And the son of the Yisroeli woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed, and they brought him to Moshe, and the name of his mother was Shelomis, daughter of Divri, of the tribe of Dan.
And they placed him in custody, to clarify for them by the word of Havayah.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Bring out the one who cursed to outside the camp, and all who heard shall lay their hands upon his head, and the whole congregation shall stone him.
And to the children of Yisroel you shall speak, saying: A man, a man who curses his Elokim, and he shall bear his sin.

And one who blasphemes the name of Havayah, he shall be put to death; the whole congregation shall stone him with stones; as the stranger, as the native, when he blasphemes the Name, he shall be put to death.
And a man, when he smites any soul of man, he shall be put to death.
And one who smites the soul of an animal shall pay for it, a soul for a soul.
And a man, when he inflicts a blemish on his fellow, as he did, so shall be done to him.
A break for a break, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth; as he inflicts a blemish on a man, so it shall be inflicted on him.
And one who smites an animal shall pay for it, and one who smites a man shall be put to death.
One judgment shall be for you; as the stranger, as the native it shall be, for I am Havayah your Elokim.
And Moshe spoke to the children of Yisroel, and they took out the one who cursed to outside the camp, and stoned him with stone, and the children of Yisroel did as Havayah commanded Moshe.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe on Mount Sinai, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: When you come into the land that I am giving to you, and the land shall rest a Shabbos to Havayah.
Six years you shall sow your field, and six years you shall prune your vineyard, and gather its produce.
And in the seventh year, a sabbath of rest it shall be for the land, a Shabbos to Havayah; your field you shall not sow, and your vineyard you shall not prune.
The aftergrowth of your harvest you shall not reap, and the grapes of your uncultivated vine you shall not gather; a year of rest it shall be for the land.
And the Shabbos of the land shall be for you for food, for you and for your slave and for your maidservant, and for your hired laborer and for your resident who sojourns with you.
And for your beast and for the wild beast that is in your land, all its produce shall be to eat.
And you shall count for yourself seven sabbaths of years, seven years seven times, and the days of the seven sabbaths of years shall be for you forty-nine years.
And you shall sound a shofar of a blast in the seventh month, on the tenth of the month; on the Day of Atonement you shall sound a shofar in all your land.

And you shall sanctify the fiftieth year, and proclaim liberty in the land to all its inhabitants; a Jubilee it shall be for you, and you shall return, each man to his ancestral portion, and each man to his family.
A Jubilee it is, the fiftieth year it shall be for you; you shall not sow, and you shall not reap its aftergrowth, and you shall not gather its uncultivated grapes.
For a Jubilee it is, holy it shall be for you; from the field you shall eat its produce.
In this Jubilee Year you shall return each man to his ancestral portion.
And when you sell a sale to your fellow, or buy from the hand of your fellow, a man shall not wrong his brother.
By the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your fellow; by the number of years of crops he shall sell to you.
According to the many years you shall increase its price, and according to the few years you shall decrease its price, for the number of crops he sells to you.
And a man shall not wrong his fellow, and you shall fear your Elokim, for I am Havayah your Elokim.
And you shall do My statutes, and My ordinances you shall keep and do them, and you shall dwell upon the land in security.
And the land shall give its produce, and you shall eat to satiety, and dwell in security upon it.
And if you say: What shall we eat in the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, and we shall not gather our produce.
And I shall command My blessing for you in the sixth year, and it shall make the produce for three years.
And you shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the old produce, until the ninth year, until the coming of its produce, you shall eat of the old.
And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for Mine is the land, for strangers and residents you are with Me.
And in all the land of your ancestral portion, you shall give redemption to the land.
When your brother becomes poor, and sells from his ancestral portion, and his redeemer, who is close to him, shall come, and redeem the sale of his brother.
And a man, when he has no redeemer, and his hand reaches, and he finds enough for his redemption.
And he shall calculate the years of its sale, and return the excess to the man to whom he sold it, and return to his ancestral portion.

And if his hand does not find enough to return to him, and his sale shall be in the hand of its buyer until the Jubilee Year, and it shall go out in the Jubilee, and he shall return to his ancestral portion.
And a man, when he sells a dwelling house in a walled city, and its redemption shall be until the end of the year of its sale; a year it shall be its redemption.

And if it is not redeemed until the completion of a full year for it, and the house that is in the city that has a wall shall stand in perpetuity to its buyer for his generations; it shall not go out in the Jubilee.
And the houses of the villages that have no wall around them, it shall be reckoned as the field of the land; redemption it shall have, and in the Jubilee it shall go out.
And as for the cities of the Leviim, the houses of the cities of their ancestral portion, there shall be eternal redemption for the Leviim.

And whoever redeems from the Leviim, and the sale of a house and the city of his ancestral portion shall go out in the Jubilee, for the houses of the cities of the Leviim are their ancestral portion among the children of Yisroel.
And the open land around their cities shall not be sold, for an eternal ancestral portion it is for them.
And when your brother becomes poor, and his hand falters with you, and you shall support him, a stranger and a resident, and he shall live with you.
You shall not take from him interest and increase, and you shall fear your Elokim, and your brother shall live with you.
Your silver you shall not give him with interest, and with increase you shall not give your food.
I am Havayah your Elokim, who brought you out of the land of Mitzrayim, to give you the land of Kena'an, to be for you as Elokim.
And when your brother becomes poor with you, and is sold to you, you shall not work him with the work of a slave.
As a hired laborer, as a resident he shall be with you; until the Jubilee Year he shall work with you.
And he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and return to his family, and he shall return to the ancestral portion of his fathers.
For My servants they are, whom I brought out of the land of Mitzrayim; they shall not be sold as a sale of a slave.
You shall not oppress him with hard labor, and you shall fear your Elokim.
And your slave and your maidservant that shall be yours, from the nations that are around you, from them you shall buy a slave and a maidservant.

And also from the children of the residents who sojourn with you, from them you shall buy, and from their families that are with you, that they begot in your land, and they shall be for you as an ancestral portion.

And you shall bequeath them to your children after you, to inherit as an ancestral portion; forever you shall work them, but with your brethren, the children of Yisroel, a man with his brother, you shall not oppress him with hard labor.

And if the hand of a stranger and a resident with you reaches, and your brother becomes poor with him, and he is sold to a stranger, a resident with you, or to an offshoot of the family of a stranger.
After he is sold, there shall be redemption for him; one of his brothers shall redeem him.
Or his uncle or the son of his uncle shall redeem him, or from the remnant of his flesh, from his family, shall redeem him, or his hand reaches, and he shall be redeemed.

And he shall calculate with his buyer from the year of his sale to him until the Jubilee Year, and the silver of his sale shall be by the number of years; as the days of a hired laborer he shall be with him.
If many years remain, according to them he shall return his redemption from the silver of his purchase.
And if few remain of the years until the Jubilee Year, and he shall calculate for him; according to his years he shall return his redemption.
As a hired laborer, year by year, he shall be with him; he shall not oppress him with hard labor before your eyes.
And if he is not redeemed by these, he shall go out in the Jubilee Year, he and his children with him.
For to Me the children of Yisroel are servants; My servants they are, whom I brought out of the land of Mitzrayim; I am Havayah your Elokim.

You shall not make for yourselves false gods, and an idol or a pillar you shall not establish for yourselves, and an ornamented stone you shall not place in your land, to bow down upon it, for I am Havayah your Elokim.
My Shabbosos you shall keep, and My Sanctuary you shall revere; I am Havayah.
If in My statutes you walk, and My commandments you keep, and do them.
And I shall give your rains in their season, and the land shall give its produce, and the tree of the field shall give its fruit.
And your threshing shall reach to the grape harvest, and the grape harvest shall reach to the sowing, and you shall eat your bread to satiety, and dwell in security in your land.
And I shall give peace in the land, and you shall lie down and none shall make you afraid, and I shall banish evil beasts from the land, and a sword shall not pass through your land.
And you shall pursue your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.
And five of you shall pursue a hundred, and a hundred of you shall pursue ten thousand, and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.
And I shall turn to you, and make you fruitful and multiply you, and establish My covenant with you.
And you shall eat old, long-stored grain, and you shall bring out the old before the new.
And I shall place My Mishkan among you, and My soul shall not reject you.
And I shall walk among you, and be for you as Elokim, and you shall be for Me as a people.
I am Havayah your Elokim, who brought you out of the land of Mitzrayim, from being slaves to them, and I broke the beams of your yoke, and caused you to walk upright.
And if you do not heed Me, and do not do all these commandments.
And if My statutes you despise, and if My ordinances your soul rejects, not to do all My commandments, to break My covenant.

I too shall do this to you, and I shall appoint over you panic, consumption and fever, consuming the eyes and causing the soul to pine, and you shall sow your seed in vain, and your enemies shall eat it.
And I shall set My face against you, and you shall be smitten before your enemies, and those who hate you shall rule over you, and you shall flee and none pursues you.
And if until these you do not heed Me, and I shall add to chastise you sevenfold for your sins.
And I shall break the pride of your strength, and make your sky like iron, and your earth like bronze.
And your strength shall be spent in vain, and your land shall not give its produce, and the tree of the land shall not give its fruit.
And if you walk with Me recalcitrantly, and do not wish to heed Me, and I shall add upon you a blow sevenfold, according to your sins.
And I shall send against you the wild beasts, and they shall bereave you, and destroy your cattle, and diminish you, and your roads shall become desolate.
And if by these you are not chastised to Me, and you walk with Me recalcitrantly.
And I shall walk, I too, with you recalcitrantly, and I shall smite you, I too, sevenfold for your sins.

And I shall bring upon you a sword, avenging the vengeance of the covenant, and you shall be gathered into your cities, and I shall send pestilence among you, and you shall be delivered into the hand of an enemy.
When I break for you the staff of bread, and ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and return your bread by weight, and you shall eat and not be satisfied.
And if with this you do not heed Me, and you walk with Me recalcitrantly.
And I shall walk with you in the fury of recalcitrance, and chastise you, I too, sevenfold for your sins.
And you shall eat the flesh of your sons, and you shall eat the flesh of your daughters.
And I shall destroy your high places, and cut down your sun idols, and place your carcasses upon the carcasses of your idols, and My soul shall reject you.
And I shall make your cities a ruin, and make your sanctuaries desolate, and I shall not smell your pleasing aroma.
And I shall make the land desolate, and your enemies who dwell in it shall be desolate upon it.
And I shall scatter you among the nations, and draw the sword after you, and your land shall be desolate, and your cities shall be ruins.
Then the land shall be repaid for its sabbaths, all the days of its desolation, and you are in the land of your enemies; then the land shall rest, and repay its sabbaths.
All the days of its desolation it shall rest, that which it did not rest in your sabbaths, when you dwelled upon it.

And as for those who remain of you, I shall bring faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, and the sound of a driven leaf shall pursue them, and they shall flee as one flees a sword, and fall, and none pursues.
And they shall stumble, a man over his brother, as before a sword, and there is no pursuer, and you shall have no standing before your enemies.
And you shall perish among the nations, and the land of your enemies shall consume you.
And those who remain of you shall molder in their iniquity in the lands of your enemies, and also in the iniquities of their fathers with them they shall molder.
And they shall confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass that they trespassed against Me, and also that they walked with Me recalcitrantly.
I too shall walk with them recalcitrantly, and bring them into the land of their enemies, or then their uncircumcised heart shall be humbled, and then they shall be repaid for their iniquity.
And I shall remember My covenant with Yackov, and also My covenant with Yitzchak, and also My covenant with Avraham I shall remember, and I shall remember the land.

And the land shall be forsaken of them, and repay its sabbaths in its desolation from them, and they shall repay their iniquity, because they despised My ordinances, and their soul rejected My statutes.
And also this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I have not despised them, and I have not rejected them, to destroy them, to break My covenant with them, for I am Havayah their Elokim.
And I shall remember for them the covenant of the first ones, that I took them out of the land of Mitzrayim before the eyes of the nations, to be for them as Elokim; I am Havayah.
These are the statutes and the ordinances and the laws that Havayah gave between Him and the children of Yisroel on Mount Sinai, by the hand of Moshe.
And Havayah spoke to Moshe, saying:
Speak to the children of Yisroel, and say to them: A man, when he utters a vow, by your valuation of souls to Havayah.
And the valuation of the male shall be, from twenty years old until sixty years old, fifty shekels of silver by the shekel of the Sanctuary.
And if a female it is, her valuation shall be thirty shekels.
And if from five years old until twenty years old, the valuation of the male shall be twenty shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
And if from one month old until five years old, the valuation of the male shall be five shekels of silver, and for the female, the valuation shall be three shekels of silver.
And if from sixty years old and upward, if a male, his valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for the female ten shekels.
And if he is too poor for your valuation, he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assess him; according to what the hand of the one who vowed can reach, the priest shall assess him.
And if an animal from which they present an offering to Havayah, all that he gives of it to Havayah shall be sacred.
He shall not exchange it, and he shall not substitute it, good for bad or bad for good; and if he substitutes an animal for an animal, it and its substitute shall be sacred.
And if any impure animal from which they do not present an offering to Havayah, he shall set the animal before the priest.
And the priest shall assess it, between good and between bad; as the valuation of the priest, so it shall be.
And if he redeems it, he shall add its fifth to its valuation.
And a man, when he consecrates his house sacred to Havayah, the priest shall assess it, between good and between bad; as the priest assesses it, so it shall stand.
And if the one who consecrated it redeems his house, he shall add a fifth of the silver of the valuation to it, and it shall be his.
And if from the field of his ancestral portion a man consecrates to Havayah, his valuation shall be according to its seed: seed of a homer of barley for fifty shekels of silver.
If he consecrates his field from the Jubilee Year, it shall stand as its valuation.

And if he consecrates his field after the Jubilee, the priest shall calculate for him the silver according to the years that remain until the Jubilee Year, and it shall be deducted from the valuation.
And if the one who consecrated the field redeems it, he shall add a fifth of the silver of the valuation to it, and it shall be his.
And if he does not redeem the field, and if he sells the field to another man, it shall no longer be redeemed.
And the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be sacred to Havayah, like a proscribed field; its portion shall be the priest's.
And if he consecrates to Havayah a field of his purchase, which is not from the field of his ancestral portion.
And the priest shall calculate for him the sum of the valuation until the Jubilee Year, and he shall give the valuation on that day, sacred to Havayah.
In the Jubilee Year the field shall return to the one from whom he bought it, to the one whose ancestral portion of the land it is.
And every valuation shall be by the shekel of the Sanctuary; twenty gerah shall be the shekel.
But a firstborn that is firstborn to Havayah among animals, no man shall consecrate it; whether ox or sheep, it is Havayah's.
And if among the impure animals, he shall redeem it by its valuation, and he shall add its fifth to it; and if it is not redeemed, it shall be sold by its valuation.

But every proscribed thing that a man proscribes to Havayah, from all that is his, from man and from animal and from the field of his ancestral portion, shall not be sold and shall not be redeemed; every proscribed thing is a holy of holies to Havayah.
Every proscribed thing that is proscribed from man shall not be ransomed; he shall be put to death.
And every tithe of the land, from the seed of the land, from the fruit of the tree, is Havayah's; sacred it is to Havayah.
And if a man redeems from his tithe, he shall add its fifth to it.
And every tithe of cattle and flock, all that passes under the rod, the tenth shall be sacred to Havayah.
He shall not distinguish between good and between bad, and he shall not substitute it; and if he substitutes it, it and its substitute shall be sacred; it shall not be redeemed.
These are the commandments that Havayah commanded Moshe for the children of Yisroel on Mount Sinai.
